title: 051. Lowest Common Ancestor Of A Binary Search Tree
javaSig: public TreeNode lowestCommonAncestor(TreeNode root, TreeNode p, TreeNode q)
prompt: Given a Binary Search Tree `root` and nodes `p` and `q`, return their Lowest Common Ancestor node.
invariant: Split point where min(p,q) <= curr.val <= max(p,q) is the LCA
firstLine: Set `curr = root` and walk down while both `p.val` and `q.val` lie on the same side of `curr.val`.
steps: If `p.val < curr.val and q.val < curr.val`, move `curr = curr.left`; elif both `> curr.val`, move `curr = curr.right`
Otherwise `curr` splits `p` and `q` (or equals one of them) — return `curr`
